name: Transmat
ownershipStory: Founded by Derrick May to release his own records, following the artist-owned model Juan Atkins had already established with Metroplex. Transmat put out Rhythim Is Rhythim's foundational releases, including 'Strings of Life' and 'Nude Photo,' both in 1987.
hook: Derrick May's own label, built on the same artist-owned model as Atkins' Metroplex.

blurb.age7: This is Derrick May's own record label in Detroit.
blurb.age13: Transmat is Derrick May's own label, started in Detroit in 1986. He used it to release his own music, including 'Strings of Life,' rather than depend on anyone else's label.
blurb.adult: Transmat follows the same artist-owned pattern Atkins set with Metroplex: Detroit techno's early makers largely kept their own masters, an unusual and consequential choice given how many artists elsewhere in this dataset did not.
